This is hymn number 182 titled "We'll Sing All Hail to Jesus' Name" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Richard Alldridge.
